description: Converge six CLI command-surface drifts to the product spec: rename show->get and remove redundant status (workflow reads); add profile enable/disable; converge issue rerun-from-stage into a flag; rename agent delete->archive; flip label remove->delete canonical; then update docs gap table and record alias decision.

tasks.title: Workflow reads: rename show->get (alias), remove redundant status
tasks.description: In MohistCliCommands.Workflow.Reads.cs rename the BuildShow command to canonical `get` and add `show` as a transitional name alias via cmd.Aliases.Add (single command, shared handler so alias cannot diverge). Hard-delete BuildStatus and its WorkflowRunStatus table-shape reference, and drop the BuildStatus registration from the workflow group in MohistCliCommands.Workflow.cs (not aliased — status is redundant, not a rename). The -o table|json|yaml semantics, the -o yaml GET .../yaml template contract, and the missing-runId local-failure are unchanged. Update the class-level comment to describe show as the alias.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo workflow get <runId>` is the canonical single-resource read; default table renders the summary (status, stage progress, approval state, issue).
`mo workflow show <runId>` runs through the same command/ handler and produces identical output and exit code to `get` under any -o table|json|yaml combination.
`mo workflow get -o yaml` GETs /api/workflow-runs/{runId}/yaml (template definition), never the JSON read model.
`mo workflow status` is no longer a registered subcommand; invoking it fails as unknown command.
Missing runId prints a '<run-id> is required' error to stderr and exits non-zero without a request.

CliWorkflowReads.cs specs cover get canonical, show-alias parity (diff requests under both names), status-gone, and -o yaml path; `dotnet test` in packages/cli/tests/Mohist.Cli.Tests passes with no real network and no wall clock.
tasks.notes: Alias strategy D1: renames keep the old name as a transitional alias. status removal is BREAKING but recency-narrow (#381).

tasks.title: Profile toggle: add mo project workflow profile enable/disable
tasks.description: Add BuildProfileEnable and BuildProfileDisable to the profile subgroup in MohistCliCommands.ProjectWorkflow.cs (today only registers list). Each takes a required positional <profileId>, resolves the project via the shared --project/--project-id (active project when neither given), and POSTs { profileId } to the existing /api/projects/{projectId}/workflow-profile/{enable,disable} endpoints. Missing profileId fails locally before any request. Server guard errors (unknown_workflow_profile, last_enabled_workflow_profile) surface verbatim through the standard PrintPostAsync error path — no CLI-side translation.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo project workflow profile enable <profileId>` POSTs {"profileId":"<profileId>"} to /api/projects/{projectId}/workflow-profile/enable.
`mo project workflow profile disable <profileId>` POSTs {"profileId":"<profileId>"} to /api/projects/{projectId}/workflow-profile/disable.
Missing <profileId> on either command fails locally with a non-zero exit without sending a request.
Project scoping honors --project / --project-id (active project when absent); unresolvable project fails locally.
unknown_workflow_profile (enable/disable) and last_enabled_workflow_profile (disable) server 400s print the error message and code to stderr and exit non-zero verbatim.

CliProjectWorkflowProfileSpecs.cs specs cover enable POST, disable POST, missing profileId local failure, --project-id routing, and both guard errors; `dotnet test` passes with HTTP faked via RecordingHttpHandler, no real network, no wall clock.
tasks.notes: D4: additive callers of existing endpoints; no server change. Closes the conventions.md Tier 2 gap.

tasks.title: Issue rerun: add --from-stage flag, keep rerun-from-stage as peer alias
tasks.description: Replace the generic BuildAction("rerun") registration in MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs with a dedicated BuildRerun mirroring WorkflowCommands.BuildRerun: a --from-stage option, a fromStageProvided (presence) check, routing to .../rerun with empty body when absent and .../rerun-from-stage with { stage } when present. Empty/whitespace --from-stage fails locally. Retain BuildRerunFromStage (MohistCliCommands.Issue.Lifecycle.cs:80) as a transitional peer command with its --stage flag (NOT a name-alias, since the flag names differ — D3); mark its description transitional so --help flags it. Both paths converge on identical wire behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo issue rerun <num>` POSTs an empty body to /api/projects/{projectId}/issues/{num}/rerun (rerun from start).
`mo issue rerun <num> --from-stage <stage>` (non-empty) POSTs {"stage":"<stage>"} to /api/projects/{projectId}/issues/{num}/rerun-from-stage.
Empty/whitespace --from-stage prints a '--from-stage is required and must not be empty' error to stderr and exits non-zero without a request.
`mo issue rerun-from-stage <num> --stage <stage>` still POSTs the same body to the same /rerun-from-stage endpoint and produces the same exit code as `rerun --from-stage`.
Project scoping honors --project / --project-id identical to other issue lifecycle commands.

CliIssueRerunFromStageSpecs.cs specs cover rerun-from-start, rerun --from-stage, empty-from-stage local failure, project scoping, and alias parity; `dotnet test` passes with no real network, no wall clock.
tasks.notes: D2/D3: mirrors workflow rerun --from-stage (#381 precedent). Peer command kept because System.CommandLine name-alias shares one option set and cannot honor both --stage and --from-stage.

tasks.title: Agent: rename delete->archive (canonical), keep delete alias
tasks.description: In MohistCliCommands.Agent.cs rename the BuildDelete command to canonical `archive` and add `delete` as a transitional name alias via cmd.Aliases.Add (single command, shared handler). Behavior is unchanged: resolve agent ref (name or agent_ id) client-side, DELETE /api/projects/{projectId}/agents/{agentId}, print 'Agent {name} ({id}) archived' on success, unresolved agent fails locally. This is a name-only flip matching the server method ArchiveAsync.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo agent archive <name-or-id>` is the canonical command; DELETEs /api/projects/{projectId}/agents/{agentId} and prints 'Agent {name} ({id}) archived' on success.
`mo agent delete <name-or-id>` produces the same request, output, and exit code as `archive` under any project scoping flags.
Unresolved agent ref prints an error to stderr and exits non-zero without sending a DELETE.

CliAgentCommandSpecs.cs specs cover archive-by-id, archive-by-name (list resolve), unresolved local failure, and delete-alias parity (diff requests under both names); `dotnet test` passes with no real network, no wall clock.
tasks.notes: D1: rename keeps old name as transitional alias. Name-only flip, no semantic change.

tasks.title: Label: flip canonical to delete, remove/rm become aliases
tasks.description: In MohistCliCommands.Label.cs flip the canonical command name from `remove` to `delete`, and make both `remove` and `rm` transitional name aliases via cmd.Aliases.Add (single command, shared handler). Behavior and endpoint are unchanged: resolve project via --project/--project-id, DELETE /api/projects/{projectId}/labels/catalog/{key}. This is a canonical/alias flip with no semantic change.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo label delete <key>` is the canonical command; DELETEs /api/projects/{projectId}/labels/catalog/{key}.
`mo label remove <key>` and `mo label rm <key>` produce the same request and exit code as `delete` under any project scoping flags.
Project scoping honors --project / --project-id (active project when neither given).

CliLabelCatalogSpecs.cs specs cover delete-by-key, --project-id routing, remove-alias parity, and rm-alias parity (diff requests under all three names); `dotnet test` passes with no real network, no wall clock.
tasks.notes: D1: rename keeps old names as transitional aliases. Canonical/alias flip, no semantic change.

tasks.title: Finalize: update cli-reference gap table and record alias-strategy decision
tasks.description: After all five command-surface changes land, remove the six now-completed rows from the implementation-gap table in docs/cli-reference.md (show->get, status removal, profile enable/disable, issue rerun --from-stage, agent delete->archive, label remove->delete). The spec body is unchanged (it already documents the target shape). Post an issue comment on #386 recording the alias-strategy decision (D1: renames keep the old name as a transitional alias; the one redundant command status is removed not aliased) plus the full transitional-alias inventory for a future cleanup issue.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/cli-reference.md implementation-gap table no longer lists any of the six items this issue converged.
No edits to the docs/cli-reference.md spec body (target shape already documented).

An issue comment on #386 records the alias-strategy decision and lists every transitional alias introduced (show, agent delete, label remove, label rm, issue rerun-from-stage) so a future cleanup has a single inventory.
Repository builds (`npm run build`) and `dotnet test` in packages/cli/tests/Mohist.Cli.Tests is green.
tasks.output: Updated docs/cli-reference.md gap table; issue comment on #386 with alias decision + inventory
tasks.notes: Comment can be posted via `mo issue comment 386 --project-id <id>`. Decision text already in design.md D1 — this is cross-referencing for the cleanup inventory.
